raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "26.1.0"
  python_check_max: "3.14"

recipe:
  name: service-identity-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/s/service-identity/service_identity-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 6358c52882c96e66ac4a55eb3a72c7dd4a70763f8cc6fa4e70abde2656f4bf3b

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python

outputs:
  - package:
      name: service-identity
    build:
      number: 0
      noarch: python
      script:
        - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation --disable-pip-version-check
    requirements:
      host:
        - hatch-fancy-pypi-readme
        - hatch-vcs
        - hatchling
        - pip
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
      run:
        - attrs >=19.1.0
        - cryptography >=47
        - python >=${{ python_min }}
      run_constraints:
        - service_identity ${{ version }}.*

  - package:
      name: service_identity
    build:
      noarch: generic
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("service-identity", upper_bound="x.x.x") }}
    tests:
      - python:
          imports: service_identity
          pip_check: false
          python_version:
            - ${{ python_min }}.*
            - ${{ python_check_max }}.*

  - package:
      name: service-identity-with-pyopenssl
    build:
      noarch: generic
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("service-identity", upper_bound="x.x.x") }}
        - pyopenssl
    tests:
      - python:
          imports: service_identity
          pip_check: false
          python_version:
            - ${{ python_min }}.*
            - ${{ python_check_max }}.*

  - package:
      name: service-identity-with-idna
    build:
      noarch: generic
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("service-identity", upper_bound="x.x.x") }}
        - idna
    tests:
      - python:
          imports: service_identity
          pip_check: false
          python_version:
            - ${{ python_min }}.*
            - ${{ python_check_max }}.*

  - package:
      name: service-identity-with-all
    build:
      noarch: generic
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("service-identity", upper_bound="x.x.x") }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("service-identity-with-idna", upper_bound="x.x.x") }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("service-identity-with-pyopenssl", upper_bound="x.x.x") }}
    tests:
      - python:
          imports: service_identity
          pip_check: true
          python_version:
            - ${{ python_min }}.*
            - ${{ python_check_max }}.*
      - files:
          source:
            - tests/
        requirements:
          run:
            - pytest-cov
            - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        script:
          - coverage run --source=service_identity --branch -m pytest -vv --tb=long --color=yes
          - coverage report --show-missing --skip-covered --fail-under=98

about:
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Service identity verification for pyOpenSSL.
  description: |
    service_identity aspires to give you all the tools you need for verifying
    whether a certificate is valid for the intended purposes.
  homepage: https://pypi.org/project/service-identity
  repository: https://github.com/pyca/service-identity
  documentation: https://service-identity.readthedocs.io

extra:
  feedstock-name: service_identity
  recipe-maintainers:
    - isuruf
    - bollwyvl
